title: Approve PRD scope, release split and requirements
decision: R1 is group-first (FEAT-001 to 006, 011, 012); R2 and R3 as listed; no paid features or API-key import; non-functional targets accepted; playful alert tone by default with per-chat neutral switch
context: Community demand is strongest in groups; owner wants private use too but accepts it in R2; humor was a loved trait of the incumbent
chosen_option: R1 group-first scope with playful default tone
rationale: Fastest path to the core promise with production quality; keeps the data model single-purpose in R1
